feature.settingsSync.name: Settings sync
feature.settingsSync.description: Keep settings the same on several computers through a folder you pick, such as one that iCloud Drive, Dropbox or Syncthing already syncs.
sync.title: Sync settings between computers
sync.body: Keep your settings the same on every computer you use. Melodesk sync (below) needs nothing set up and carries everything, even sign-ins, encrypted so nobody else can read it. You can also keep a small file in your iCloud Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox or Google Drive, if this computer has one.
sync.off: Not syncing yet. Choose where to keep your settings:
sync.what: Synced through iCloud Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox, Google Drive or GitHub: appearance, sound and feature choices, lyrics settings, smart playlists, podcast subscriptions, radio stations, and which plugins are on with their settings. Passwords, plugin sign-ins, tokens and your music server stay on each computer there, because whoever opens that folder could read them; only Melodesk sync (encrypted) carries those. Folders and listening history are never synced (use Back up and restore).
sync.how: Each setting keeps its newest change, so changes made on two computers both survive. Keep the computers’ clocks right.
sync.notOurs: The sync file in that folder is not a Melodesk sync file, so it was left alone.
sync.reload.body: Settings from another computer were applied. Reload to use them.
whatsNew.v0_9_0.a: Sync settings between computers through a folder you pick (iCloud Drive, Dropbox, Syncthing…). No Melodesk server or account; find it in Settings → Storage.
whatsNew.v0_9_0.b: Appearance, sound, feature choices, lyrics settings, smart playlists, podcasts and radio stations follow you; passwords, servers and folders stay on each computer.
feature.youtubeMusic.name: YouTube Music
feature.youtubeMusic.description: YouTube Music as a source of playback, and the pages that browse it (home, search, library). The official web player does the playing, signing in and ads. Switch it off to close the hidden player and send nothing to YouTube; your own music, servers, podcasts and radio keep working.
whatsNew.section.body: You are on version {version}. See what each version added.
sync.git: This folder is a git repository: Melodesk pulls before it reads, and commits and pushes after it writes, using the git on this computer and your own sign-in (an SSH key or credential helper). It never sees a GitHub password or token.
player.adNotSkippable: This ad has no Skip button yet, or cannot be skipped
whatsNew.v0_10_0.a: YouTube Music can be switched off in Settings → Features. The hidden player is closed, nothing is sent to YouTube, and the app opens on your own music.
whatsNew.v0_10_0.b: Skip ad: when YouTube’s own Skip button is offered on an ad, press Skip ad in the player bar. Nothing is skipped or hidden by itself.
whatsNew.v0_10_0.c: Settings sync can use a GitHub repository: pick a clone of a private repo and Melodesk pulls and pushes with your own git sign-in.
whatsNew.v0_10_0.d: Plugins sync too: which are on and their settings. Sign-ins and tokens stay on each computer.
sync.noClouds: No iCloud Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox or Google Drive folder was found on this computer. Sign in with GitHub, or choose any folder that something else keeps in step.
sync.github.type: GitHub is open in your browser. Type this code there and approve:
sync.github.only: Melodesk asks GitHub only for permission to use your gists (to keep one secret file). It never sees your password, and you can take the permission back at github.com/settings/applications.
sync.github.denied: GitHub was told no, so nothing was connected.
sync.github.expired: The code ran out before it was used. Try again.
sync.github.signedOut: GitHub no longer accepts this computer’s sign-in. Stop syncing and sign in again.
whatsNew.v0_11_0.a: Settings sync is one click now: if this computer has iCloud Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox or Google Drive, Settings → Storage offers it. Nothing to install and no folder to pick.
whatsNew.v0_11_0.b: Sync can also go through a GitHub account, signing in with a code (no GitHub app or command line needed).
sync.where.server: Syncing through the Melodesk sync server, encrypted end to end.
sync.server.title: Melodesk sync (everything, including sign-ins)
sync.server.body: Keeps your whole configuration the same on every computer: the settings above plus plugin sign-ins (Last.fm, ListenBrainz…) and your music server. It is encrypted on this computer with a sync code before it is sent, so Melodesk’s server only ever holds unreadable data. Nothing to set up: start on one computer, then type the code on the others.
sync.server.haveCode: I already have a sync code
sync.server.codeLabel: Sync code from your other computer
sync.server.writeDown: Write this sync code down, or copy it somewhere safe. You type it on your other computers to join. It never leaves your computers, so nobody can read your settings without it.
sync.server.noRecovery: If every computer loses the code, the settings on the server cannot be read again: there is no reset, because the server cannot read them either.
sync.server.badCode: That is not a sync code. It has 20 letters and digits, in groups of four.
sync.server.noSuchCode: Nothing is saved under that code. Check it, or start syncing on your other computer first.
sync.server.lostCode: This computer no longer has the sync code (or it does not fit what is on the server). Stop syncing and join again with your code.
sync.server.conflict: Another computer changed the settings at the same moment. It will be tried again.
whatsNew.v0_13_0.a: Your whole configuration can sync, sign-ins included (Last.fm, ListenBrainz, your music server). It is encrypted on your computer with a sync code, so Melodesk’s server reads nothing.
whatsNew.v0_14_0.a: Video works again: the video button now uses YouTube Music’s own Song/Video switch and shows the picture filling its window, and it says so when a song has no video.
whatsNew.v0_14_0.b: Skip ad finds YouTube’s Skip button wherever the page puts it.
